_comment.about: The Next.js half of the hosting product (hosting/frappe is the Frappe half: the six Hosting Subscription Plan seed records and their Items). Ray, 2026-09-09: hosting is "a seperate frontend for rokctapp, but it points to control site. just hosting focused and filter subscriptions to show only hosting related" - and rokctapp's own storefront filters those same plans out (agent_sdk 1.10.0). hosting/docs/spec.md: rpanel stays a standalone product, so this SDK is a STOREFRONT on the control site and nothing more - no control panel, no signed-in home. It is the hosting shell's home SDK (core/utils/frappe/composer/hosting.json flags it home_sdk: true, beside telemetry_sdk, base_sdk and auth_sdk; no agent_sdk, whose integrations are unconditional and flip the shell AI-first), so it owns app/page.tsx (every visitor is redirected to base_sdk's composed landing at /landing; there is no signed-in home to send anyone to) and fills every seam base_sdk's landing host offers with ONE registered module each: components/custom/landing/hosting-hero-copy.ts at // @rokct-sdk-hero-copy-start (base_sdk >= 1.6.0's hero-copy.ts; the three things every plan is sized by cycle as the headline, the trust line states the two facts all six plans share), hosting-hero-form.tsx at // @rokct-sdk-hero-form-start (base_sdk >= 1.7.0's hero-form.ts; two calls to action and no input, as lms-hero-form.tsx: the sign-up and the pricing section - the base hero draws no call to action of its own without a registered body), hosting-features-section.tsx and hosting-pricing-section.tsx at // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start (base_sdk >= 1.11.0's page-sections.ts; the pricing section declares meta.renders over the prefetched rows so the section and its Pricing nav stop drop together when the control site returns none), hosting-header-menu.ts at // @rokct-sdk-header-menu-start (base_sdk >= 1.14.0's header-menu.ts; two anchors, features and pricing, resolved against the page's live nav; no groups, and no actions because base's header already draws Log in and Sign up; since 1.0.1 brand: { logo: "none" }, base_sdk >= 1.21.0's HeaderMenu.brand - the home SDK declares whether the header shows a logo, Ray 2026-09-09 14:15Z, and hosting has no icon yet, so the header draws the wordmark alone), hosting-site-metadata.ts at // @rokct-sdk-site-metadata-start (base_sdk >= 1.15.0's site-metadata.ts; declares its own SiteMetadataCopy-shaped interface rather than importing base's, as lms and agent do; no icon, so base_sdk >= 1.17.0's generated letter favicon applies), and hosting-plans-query.ts at // @rokct-sdk-plans-query-start (base_sdk >= 1.9.0's plans-query.ts; LANDING_CONFIG.plansQuery with ONE filter laid over its payload, ["plan_category", "=", "Hosting"], the inclusive mirror of agent-plans-query.ts; no plan id or name anywhere in the filter). Their copy is components/custom/landing/hosting-page-sections.ts and the hero and metadata modules; every claim is a fact from hosting/frappe/src/fixtures (plan tiers, website/database/storage sizes, the feature lines, the 14-day trial, USD, monthly and yearly billing) or hosting/frappe/README.md, and nothing a source does not carry is said. Colours route through the shell's theme tokens (bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, the zinc surfaces), never a literal brand colour. The base_sdk floor is 1.21.0 (since 1.0.1): hosting-header-menu.ts declares HeaderMenu.brand, which base_sdk 1.21.0 added, and against an older base the field is unknown to the registry's type and the compose fails to type-check. 1.0.0's floor was 1.19.0: the home_sdk composer (protocol #390) injects only the home SDK's line at the single-answer markers (header-menu, hero-form, plans-query, site-metadata) and base 1.19.0 is the version that shipped with it on the rokctai_frontend refresh; every other registry this SDK targets exists from 1.15.0 (1.17.0 for the generated favicon this SDK relies on by shipping no icon). base_sdk composes first, auth_sdk before this SDK because the landing's sign-up and login links are its routes.
